children: Morocco and the African Development Bank (AfDB) have signed a €205 million ($241 million) loan agreement to support the development of railway infrastructure along the Kenitra-Marrakech corridor, local Arabic language newspaper Hespress reported on Tuesday.
The railway loan was one of two financing agreements worth a combined €405 million ($475 million) signed by Morocco and the AfDB in Rabat.
The financing will support the extension of the high-speed rail line and reinforcement of existing railway infrastructure along the Kenitra-Marrakech corridor, the report said.
(Writing by Majda Muhsen; Editing by Anoop Menon)
